summary: ACDC #191 把后量子和后 AI 加固定为首要议题，讨论把紧迫度从 DEFCON 4 提到 2 至 3，EIP-8483（后量子材料注册）获得 Hegotá 的 PFI 状态。FOCIL 和 quick slots 的去留、后量子 Gasper 还是 decoupled consensus 都还没定。账户方向上 EIP-8430（AA 交易类型）调整赞助交易的计费，新草案 EIP-8500 处理 FOCIL 与 Frame 交易的兼容。

items.topic: ACDC #191：后量子成为首要议题，Hegotá 范围未定
items.title: ACDC #191 会议纪要
items.note: 2026-11-13 00:04 发布（会议于 2026-11-12 21:00 举行，Ben Edgington 首次主持）。纪要写明：会议讨论是否把后量子和后 AI 加固的紧迫度从 DEFCON 4 提到 DEFCON 2 至 3，理由是 AI 数学能力进展快于预期；Hegotá 是否纳入 FOCIL 和 quick slots 有争论；后量子 Gasper 被认为复杂，需要和后量子 decoupled consensus（PQDC）对比评估；EIP-8483 后量子材料注册被接受为 Hegotá 的 PFI。下次 ACDC 定在 11 月 26 日。
items.title_en: ACDC #191 meeting notes
items.note_en: Were posted 2026-11-13 00:04 (the call ran 2026-11-12 21:00, with Ben Edgington chairing for the first time). The notes say the call debated raising the urgency of post-quantum and post-AI hardening from DEFCON 4 to DEFCON 2 or 3, because AI math capabilities are moving faster than expected. Including FOCIL and quick slots in Hegotá was contested. Post-quantum Gasper was seen as complex and needs to be weighed against post-quantum decoupled consensus (PQDC). EIP-8483, post-quantum material registration, was accepted as PFI for Hegotá. The next ACDC is set for November 26.

items.title: EIP 草案：leanVM 聚合以影子模式与 BLS 并行运行
items.note: 2026-11-12 22:38 由 sauliusgrigaitis 发布：验证者同时产生 BLS 签名和后量子哈希签名，共识只认 BLS，leanVM 的聚合和证明只做测量对比；等到 BLS 不再安全时，用紧急硬分叉切到 leanVM。这对应纪要里 saulius 要写的“分阶段上线”提案。
items.title_en: Draft EIP: run leanVM aggregation in shadow mode alongside BLS
items.note_en: Posted 2026-11-12 22:38 by sauliusgrigaitis. Validators would produce both a BLS signature and a post-quantum hash-based signature, consensus would rely on BLS alone, and leanVM aggregates and proofs would only be measured and compared. Once BLS is no longer safe, an emergency hard fork would switch over to leanVM. This matches the staged rollout write-up assigned to saulius in the notes.

items.title: EIP-8430（AA Transaction Type）PR 新提交：赞助交易要为 sender 的账户访问付费
items.note: 2026-11-13 04:58 推送。EIP-8430 是从 EIP-8130 拆出来的独立 EIP-2718 交易类型，不依赖 Keystore，现有 EOA 用原生 secp256k1 就能用：分阶段批量调用、gas 代付（bound 和 open 两种 payer 模式）、2D nonce 与免 nonce 模式，以及交易内的 EIP-7702 式代码委托。
items.title_en: A new commit on the EIP-8430 (AA Transaction Type) PR makes sponsored transactions pay for the sender's account access
items.note_en: Pushed 2026-11-13 04:58. EIP-8430 is a standalone EIP-2718 transaction type split out of EIP-8130 with no Keystore dependency. Today's EOAs can use it with native secp256k1: phased call batching, gas sponsorship (bound and open payer modes), 2D nonces and a nonce-free mode, and in-band EIP-7702-style code delegation.

items.title: 新 EIP 草案 EIP-8500：Frame 交易的 FOCIL 遗漏见证
items.note: 2026-11-13 07:53 由 AnkushinDaniil 提交，建立在 EIP-7805（FOCIL）和 EIP-8369 之上：payload envelope 携带遗漏判定依赖的已签名包含列表，bid 承诺其根；被遗漏的 Frame 交易在一个由 BAL 推导出的检查点判定；每笔和每个包含列表的 gas 上限是必须项，具体数值待测。
items.title_en: New draft EIP-8500: FOCIL omission witnesses for Frame transactions
items.note_en: Opened 2026-11-13 07:53 by AnkushinDaniil and built on EIP-7805 (FOCIL) and EIP-8369. The payload envelope carries the signed inclusion lists an omission relies on, and the bid commits to their root. An omitted Frame transaction is judged at a check point derived from the BAL. Per-transaction and per-list gas caps are mandatory, with values still to be measured.

items.title: ethresear.ch：More Meters or More Prices? 一维与多维费用机制对比
items.note: 2026-11-12 22:28 由 Fei Wu 发布（EF 实习期间完成）：比较 EIP-7999 多维费用市场与 Glamsterdam 后的一维方案；文中称最强的一维基准在区块级需求波动下每块提供 1.519 亿到 1.779 亿执行 gas，状态增长每年 86.0 到 88.1 GiB，低于 120 GiB 的目标。对理解 gas 上限和状态 gas 定价有参考价值。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: More Meters or More Prices? One- vs. multi-dimensional fee mechanisms on Ethereum
items.note_en: Posted 2026-11-12 22:28 by Fei Wu (work done during an EF internship). It compares EIP-7999's multidimensional fee market with the post-Glamsterdam one-dimensional design. The post says the strongest one-dimensional benchmark delivers 151.9M to 177.9M execution gas per block under block-level demand variation, with 86.0 to 88.1 GiB/year of state growth against a 120 GiB target. Useful background on gas limits and state gas pricing.

summary_en: ACDC #191 made post-quantum and post-AI hardening the top agenda item, debating whether to raise the urgency from DEFCON 4 to DEFCON 2 or 3, and EIP-8483 (post-quantum material registration) was accepted as PFI for Hegotá. Whether FOCIL and quick slots stay, and whether to pursue post-quantum Gasper or decoupled consensus, is still open. On accounts, EIP-8430 (the AA transaction type) changes how sponsored transactions are charged, and a new draft, EIP-8500, makes Frame transactions work with FOCIL.
